fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. CCAF foot platoons anchor the Confederation's garrison network, holding worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they depend on prepared positions and local knowledge to offset their lack of mobility. These small special operations fireteams carry a mix of assault rifles and blazer laser rifles, combining conventional and energy weapons for maximum tactical flexibility during infiltration and direct action missions.
